units.matrixConvention: 4x4 row-major, column vectors: p_target = M · [p_local, 1]. 'solidworksArrayData' is IMathTransform.ArrayData unchanged (rotation [0..8] = images of local X,Y,Z axes, translation [9..11], scale [12]).
